propositions: A single project's base-query transport error (4xx, 5xx, timeout, rate-limit) aborts the entire reconciler pass for all projects due to lack of per-project error isolation in the query loop
The enrichment loop already implements per-project fail-open resilience via _enrich_project, but the base-query loop never inherited this isolation pattern
Partial keys from a failed project's incomplete reads leak into the shared snapshot and are misinterpreted as deletions by the differ

_fetch_project helper (symmetric to _enrich_project) must drain both base queries into a local dict and merge atomically into snapshot only on success, discarding the local dict on any transport error
Per-project transport errors must emit fetcher-project-fetch-failed alerts naming the project and pass_id, while invalid project keys and pagination stalls still fail the entire pass
